Record notes

Build and refine MCP apps with two complete methods and the attributed Alpic source.

Version 1.0.2 includes 2 complete skill procedures. Complete methods and Apache source; no provider-hosted service.

Requirements: Host coding tools; Runtime named by the selected workflow.

License scope: Apache-2.0. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add build-mcp-apps@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files and includes a per-file hash inventory. Built from 65519bccb27654c9cc9bfd1878ed0084b48316a9. SHA-256: 05e8baeb425e5b3c68eb36bc3abd97b4c1818914f0b6a9ea39d2938305ae4830.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
